component: checks/semantic/* and other checks that read snapshot.full_dom with regular expressions
summary: Checks that extract elements from the serialized DOM with regular expressions treat markup inside raw-text elements (style, script, noscript, template) as real elements, so they report on markup the browser never rendered. Replaces review fix 4 (accessible names read before scripts run), whose cause was disproved.
evidence: scan 8e03985c: image_link_no_alt on the header logo link on 49 pages (2 rows), although the header was inside an unclosed style element and never rendered; DOM-text checks (missing_autocomplete 163 occurrences / 50 pages) matched the healthy scan 0705da2d (161 / 49) while axe saw blank pages. summary: Model prompt context includes volatile page text, so live scans send a different prompt for the same element on each load. GrowSurf injects a stylesheet whose class is grsf-unique-<Math.random()>; before P2-012 the link-text context (and the alt-text surrounding context) included style and script text, so every page's link-text prompt changed per load. Effects: no response reuse across scans, run-to-run variation in model verdicts, and unreplayable eval runs. Seeding Math.random in eval replays (commit e49f11f) fixes replay only, not live scans.
evidence: replay-20261014T231224Z-055f8c: 54 response-cache misses against record-20261014T225224Z-d73465, 49 of them link_text_quality (one per page); the two runs' /brands prompts differ only in .grsf-unique-3goiz vs .grsf-unique-djygj. All 57 occurrences of grsf-unique in recorded prompts are in CSS text inside link-text context (none in element attributes). On scan 0705da2d, removing raw-text contents changes the alt-text surrounding context of 1,608 images.

labels.GrowSurf id comes from Math.random: observed (growsurf.js source in the corpus HAR)

summary: The error-message prompt takes the first 8,000 characters of the post-submission DOM (P2-001), which begin with the <html> element. Webflow's font loader adds wf-<family>-<variant>-active classes to <html> in the order fonts finish loading, so the prompt changes on each load: responses are not reused across scans and eval replays miss the cache.

Pages excluded from corpus tuning-v2 for this reason.
